say:0:1434401001:1.text:
Bethwyn cherished the warmth of a crowd, and trembled at the thought of being alone.
Before time could erase her from memory, Caiden found his way to her side.
say:0:1434401001:1.source_cn: 贝丝薇喜欢热闹，害怕寂寞。\n在被生者彻底遗忘之前，凯...

say:1:1434401002:1.text:
Bethwyn... it's time for you and Caiden to be together again.
Now, in the quiet of the night—you'll never be alone.
say:1:1434401002:1.source_cn: 贝丝薇，你现在应该已经和凯登重逢了吧。\n在无声的夜里...
